name: Christians
overview: Scripture reveals that the identity of Christians is deeply rooted in their relationship with Christ, as seen in Galatians 2:20 where believers live by faith in the Son of God who gave Himself for them. The term 'Christian' was first used to describe the disciples in Antioch, highlighting their distinctiveness as followers of Christ (Acts 11:26). While the call to be a Christian can be compelling, as noted in Acts 26:28, it requires a commitment to live in Christ’s name and give thanks to God in all actions (Colossians 3:17). The healing ministry of Jesus (Matthew 4:24) underscores the transformative power available to those who follow Him, setting a foundation for how Christians engage with the world and each other.
